newsitem.title: USA: Elizabeth Taylor could leave hospital soon.
newsitem.headline: Elizabeth Taylor could leave hospital soon.

text.p: Oscar-winning actress Elizabeth Taylor is recovering well from brain surgery and hopes to be released from the hospital in time for her 65th birthday on Thursday, her publicist said on Tuesday.
"Doctors are extremely pleased with her progress. She (Taylor) is in great spirits," said Shirene Coburn.
Taylor underwent delicate surgery for nearly four hours last Thursday as surgeons removed an apparently benign tumour the size of a golf ball from the lining of her brain.
Coburn said Taylor's doctors had not yet decided when the actress could be discharged from Cedars-Sinai Medical Centre, but hoped to let her leave Wednesday or Thursday.

"She is planning on going home tomorrow," said Coburn, who said Taylor got a lift Monday night watching the television recording of her gala Hollywood birthday party held the day before she entered the famed Beverly Hills hospital. Her actual birthday is February 27.
